  • Methodendetails

    • writeStep

      public void writeStep(double time, int vehicleCount, double avgSpeed, boolean congestionPresent, Map<String,Integer> trafficLightStates)
      Writes a single row of simulation data to the CSV file. Each call records the current simulation time, vehicle statistics, congestion status, and the number of traffic lights in each state.
      Parameter:
      time - the current simulation time
      vehicleCount - the number of active vehicles
      avgSpeed - the average speed of all vehicles
      congestionPresent - whether congestion is currently detected
      trafficLightStates - a map containing counts of traffic lights by state ("R", "Y", "G")

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the CSV file. Must be called once when the simulation ends.
